#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long a[3], b[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> b[i];
    
    long long maxWins = 0;
    long long minNotWins = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        maxWins += min(a[i], b[(i+1)%3]);
        long long lose = min(b[i], a[(i+1)%3]);
        long long draw = min(b[i], a[i]);
        minNotWins += min(b[i], lose + draw);
    }
    cout << n - minNotWins << " " << maxWins << "\n";
    return 0;
}
